page_title: LOR 3-3 HAV | Lorient v Le Havre 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.

90+3' 3 - 3 What a GOAL that is! Andre Ayew (Le Havre) showed great determination to get to the ball inside the box and acrobatically launched himself into the air and produced a scissor kick of the highest quality to leave Yvon Mvogo helpless. He makes it 3:3.
90+1' 3 - 2 Imran Louza executes the free kick and sends it inside the box where it's met by Mohamed Bamba (Lorient). He plants a header in off the crossbar. The score is 3:2.
90+1' Jeremy Stinat interrupts the game. One of the players from Le Havre won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Lorient will take a free kick.
90+1' The free kick from long range, taken by Lorient, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' One of the players from Le Havre times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
85' 2 - 2 The ball is whipped in from the free kick and finds the head of Andre Ayew (Le Havre), who rises and produces an amazing header inside the right post.
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Yassine Kechta as he is replaced by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre).
83' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

81' Imran Louza (Lorient) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from the edge of the box. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
80' It looks like Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) saw red with that tackle. Jeremy Stinat won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Lorient have a free kick.
79' Substitution. Nathaniel Adjei (Lorient) on for Panos Katseris.
78' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 13:14.
73' Imran Louza (Lorient) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
73' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Christopher Operi (Le Havre), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
70' Here comes a substitution. Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) is brought on as a substitute for Josue Casimir.
70' Here is a change. Daler Kuzyaev is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Andre Ayew (Le Havre).
69' It's time for a substitution. Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) comes on in place of Eli Junior Kroupi.
63' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close!
63' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
63' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
61' Panos Katseris (Lorient) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
59' 9:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
56' Luka Elsner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) replacing Emmanuel Sabbi.
56' The referee allows time for a substitution. Loic Nego will be replaced by Steve Ngoura (Le Havre).

55' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) who loops his header high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
55' Le Havre force their opponents to concede a corner.

54' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the roof of the net is comfortably saved by Yvon Mvogo. Le Havre earn a corner.
54' A player from Lorient commits a rough challenge. Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. That's a free kick to Le Havre.
51' 2 - 1 Goal! Ayman Kari (Lorient) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 2:1.
51' Isaak Toure (Lorient) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
51' Imran Louza (Lorient) will deliver the corner kick.

50' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lorient.
48' The foul by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jeremy Stinat.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+1' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
45+1' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) inside the box.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Today's referee Jeremy Stinat rightly decides to book Imran Louza (Lorient) for his harsh tackle.
43' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
42' A yellow card for a tackle by Julien Ponceau (Lorient). Jeremy Stinat doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
41' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Arthur Desmas anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.

40' What a wasted opportunity by Panos Katseris (Lorient)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the right side of the goal, but Arthur Desmas makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
40' Corner kicks – 0:2.
37' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one.
36' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jeremy Stinat ignores the protests.
33' 1 - 1 Goal! Ayman Kari slips it to Imran Louza (Lorient) on the edge of the box and he finds the left side of the net with a great effort. The score is 1:1.
33' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
31' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) hammers the ball towards the roof of the net, but it's not so easy to put it beyond Yvon Mvogo, who denies him with a terrific save.
31' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) will take a corner kick.
31' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Le Havre have a corner.
30' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lorient was in an offside position.

26' Isaak Toure (Lorient) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went wide of the right post by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
26' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) sees a yellow card from Jeremy Stinat after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
25' Lorient hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
23' Total attempts – 2:2.
21' A pass into the box finds Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Arthur Desmas denies him.
20' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.

19' Close! Christopher Operi (Le Havre) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
18' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
17' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Panos Katseris (Lorient) for a tough tackle.
15' 0 - 1 Goal! Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yvon Mvogo into the bottom right corner.
15' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
13' Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul after Julien Laporte (Lorient) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Penalty awarded! Le Havre will take a penalty kick.
8' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lorient, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' One of the Le Havre players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Lorient.
5' Julien Laporte (Lorient) makes a terrific run to get on the end of the free kick and powers a header just over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
4' Loic Nego (Le Havre) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jeremy Stinat signals. Lorient earn a free kick.
3' Lorient are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lorient will kick the game off.
Jeremy Stinat was nominated as the referee for this game.
